recap.text: Carl's platinum quest box for keeping Orthrus alive holds a black leather tome with a skull on the cover, which glows and adds Ping to his list. Ping costs five mana, cools down in five minutes, and reaches one kilometre, plus 500 metres per ten points of intelligence. Everything it hits hears the ping but not where it came from. Carl is disappointed it does not work on mobs or crawlers, but reckons it suits the sixth and ninth floors.

Ping costs five mana and reveals everything past the map edge that is not a crawler or red-tagged. The found targets hear the ping, so the System names the spell the Night Dread. In a castle of robots, the spell finds almost nothing except a drake, which appears orange on the map as somebody's pet.

beats.headline: A skull on the cover
beats.text: The platinum quest box Carl earned for keeping Orthrus alive holds a magical tome: black leather, a skull on the cover. Opened, it glows and adds the spell to his list. Ping costs five mana, cools down in five minutes, and reaches one kilometre round the caster plus 500 metres for every ten points of intelligence, marking every non-crawler and non-red-tagged mob, even past the edge of the map. Everything it hits hears the ping, but not where it came from. The elven gunnery officers of the Dream all learn it the moment they reach adulthood. Carl is disappointed that it does not work on mobs or crawlers, but reckons it is a spell for the sixth and ninth floors, where it will find NPCs, elites and hunters.
beats.gist: Ping is a spell costing five mana that marks every non-crawler, non-red-tagged mob within a kilometre-plus radius.

beats.headline: Here piggy, piggy
beats.text: Five mana, and it tells you where everything is that is neither a crawler nor red-tagged, out past the edge of the map. Everything it finds hears the ping, though not where it came from, which is why the System files it under names like the Night Dread and says it is for those who do not care if their quarry knows they are coming. In a castle full of robots it turns up almost nothing, which is how a drake stands out: orange on the map, somebody's pet.
beats.gist: Ping costs five mana and reveals non-crawler, non-red-tagged things beyond the map, alerting the quarry.
